title: perf(canary): add hysteresis and rollout guards to automated perf canary detection
author: Alyssa Chen
description:
Motivation: Our perf canary pipeline was too sensitive to transient noise which caused spurious rollbacks and noisy alerts. This PR implements a hysteresis layer in the canary detector and expands rollout guard policies to prevent flapping during short-lived latency/throughput spikes.

What this changes: Adds a configurable hysteresis window and state machine to the perf-detector service, introduces a minimum confirmation window (N consecutive offending windows) before marking a candidate as degraded, and plugs these signals into the rollout controller so automatic rollouts can be paused or slow-rolled instead of fully rolling back. Also updates canary metrics and dashboards and adds end-to-end tests for injected regressions.

Design notes: - Hysteresis is parameterized by window_size, required_confirmations, and cool_down_period. Default conservative values chosen to avoid missing real regressions while reducing flapping. - Rollout guard policies: pause_on_regression (boolean), slow_roll_percentage (int), and auto_abort_threshold (int). The rollout controller now supports 'pause' and 'slow-roll' actions. - Integration: perf-detector publishes verdicts to /events/perf-canary and the rollout-controller subscribes; we keep existing fallback to manual review.

Testing: unit tests for detector state transitions, integration test that injects a 15% tail-latency regression and asserts pause behavior, and canary e2e with synthetic load. Benchmarks show false-positive rate reduced by ~78% on historical noisy traces while still catching sustained regressions within two windows.

Rollout: feature flagged behind canary.hysteresis.enabled; rollout to prod via gradual enablement on perf-canary namespace and will be monitored for 48h. See ENG-9273 for rollout plan and dashboards.

Checklist: - [x] Detector state machine implemented - [x] Rollout controller pause/slow-roll actions - [x] Unit & integration tests - [x] Dashboard updates - [x] Docs/Linear references
